newsitem.title: USA: Regis buys two salons in Richmond, Va..
newsitem.headline: Regis buys two salons in Richmond, Va..

text.p: Regis Corp on Thursday said it acquired two Richmond, Va., beauty salons, which generate about $750,000 in annual sales.
Regis will operate the salons as part of its Trade Secret division.
Terms of the transaction were withheld.
Including these transactions, Regis has completed 51 acquisition deals in the past 36 months, adding 1,666 salons generating annualized revenue of $231 million and system-wide sales of $451 million.
Regis is the largest owner, operator and franchisor of hair and retail-product salons in the world. It vurrently operates and franchises 3,187 salons.
Shares of Regis were trading at 15-1/4, unchanged from Wednesday's Nasdaq close.
